raw.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
raw.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Product Manager, AI Systems, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

raw.description:
Du trägst das Herz auf der Zunge und zählst Networking zu Deinen Hobbies? Du könntest sogar den Grinch von Weihnachten überzeugen? Du hast Lust auf ein dynamisches, hochmotiviertes Team mit verschiedensten Hintergründen? Du möchtest Scale-Up Luft schnuppern und Deiner Sales-Karriere in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen einen Boost geben? Dann solltest Du weiter lesen!

Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Unsere preisgekrönte Awareness-Plattform unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltige Verhaltensänderungen durch effektive, interaktive Trainings rund um Cyber-Sicherheit und Datenschutz zu erzielen. Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr – werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit!

So trägst du zum Erfolg bei:

  • Du sprichst gezielt SMB-Accounts an – per Cold Calling, E-Mail, LinkedIn und weiteren Outbound-Taktiken.

  • Du hast täglich Cold Calling Blöcke und planst strukturierte Outreach-Aktivitäten – in dieser Rolle ist täglicher Outbound ein Muss.

  • Du qualifizierst eingehende Leads und identifizierst Accounts mit hohem Potenzial für weitere Gespräche.

  • Du vereinbarst Meetings mit Kunden und entwickelst frühe Opportunities weiter, um unsere Sales-Pipeline zu füllen.

  • Du hältst alle Interaktionen, Notizen und Opportunity-Status aktuell und sauber im CRM fest.

  • Du arbeitest auf ambitionierte Ziele hin und gibst jeden Tag 100%, um sie zu erreichen oder zu übertreffen.

  • Du baust ein tiefes Verständnis für unser Produkt, unsere Buyer Personas und die Wettbewerbslandschaft auf.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren AEs und dem Marketing-Team zusammen – ihr stimmt euch zum idealen Kundenprofil (ICP) ab, teilt Feedback aus dem Markt und optimiert gemeinsam eure Outreach-Strategien.

Was dich auszeichnet:

  • Erste Erfahrung in einer kundenorientierten Rolle (z. B. Sales, Kundenservice oder Recruiting) ist ein Plus

  • Du bist offen für Feedback, lernbereit und motiviert, dich ständig weiterzuentwickeln

  • Du kommunizierst klar, hörst aktiv zu und trittst im Kundendialog selbstbewusst auf

  • Du bleibst auch unter Druck organisiert und verfolgst deine Ziele fokussiert

  • Du fühlst dich wohl in einem schnelllebigen, dynamischen Umfeld mit schnellen Entscheidungswegen und wenig starren Prozessen

  • Du bringst ein Growth Mindset mit und gibst nicht auf, wenn’s mal herausfordernd wird – du willst dich weiterentwickeln!

  • Du bist performance-orientiert und möchtest mit deinen Ergebnissen überzeugen

  • Erfahrung mit CRM- und Outreach-Tools ist ein Plus

  • Du bist bereit, mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Köln zu arbeiten (hybrides Modell)

  • Du sprichst Deutsch fließend und hast gute Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch

So trägst du dazu bei:

  • Als Sales Development Representative DACH nimmst du zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträger*innen im IT-Sicherheitsbereich Kontakt auf und generierst sowie qualifizierst wertvolle Leads.

  • Du sicherst die Kundengewinnung durch gezielte Email Ansprache und Social Selling.

  • Du bist für die aktive, telefonische Ansprache sowie Betreuung potenzieller Neukund*innen verantwortlich.

  • Du setzt kreative, „out of the box“ Sales-Taktiken ein, um deine Pipeline kontinuierlich auszubauen.

  • Du präsentierst unser SaaS-Produkt sowohl am Telefon, in Online-Meetings als auch auf Events direkt bei Kund*innen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives zusammen, um neue Kund*innen erfolgreich zu gewinnen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Erfahrung im SMB- oder Corporate Sales im DACH-Markt und Lust, deine Expertise weiter auszubauen.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Freude daran, mit Kund*innen im DACH-Markt zu interagieren.

  • Strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise, auch in stressigen Situationen behältst du den Überblick.

  • Ehrgeiz, Motivation und Leistungsorientierung – du packst Dinge direkt an.

  • Teamfähigkeit und Lust mit Automatisierungen und KI-gestützten Workflows zu arbeiten.

  • Begeisterung, gemeinsam mit unserem Team zu wachsen.

  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Möglichst zeitnaher Start bei uns.

  • Die Möglichkeit in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodel zu arbeiten.

Was wir bieten*:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit

  • Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte, sowie Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits mit Urban Sports Club

  • Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen

  • Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro

*Die oben genannten Vergünstigungen gelten für Vollzeitmitarbeiter und können je nach Standort leicht variieren. Dies ist nur eine Auswahl – mehr erfahren Sie im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses.

Über uns

Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen.
Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln.

Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen.

Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

We are looking for a Patent Analyst with a focus in Computing, Electrical Communication, Electronic Engineering, or Physics to join our team! This is an amazing opportunity to put your technical knowledge to use by researching and analyzing cutting edge technologies at Clarivate.

Work with us as a remote independent contractor in this flexible 1099 role supporting our contract with the US Patent & Trademark Office (USPTO). Our team has supported the USPTO by providing PCT Chapter I Search and Examination services since 2005. As an independent contractor, you will be responsible for performing a comprehensive search and a written opinion on the patentability of an array of diverse technologies. If selected, you will be expected to perform the work in accordance with the terms of a consulting agreement to be presented to you for consideration by Clarivate

About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Technology, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, or related field

  • 1+ year of experience working with patents or in the intellectual property field

  • 1+ year of work experience in the industry or advanced research in a related field

  • Must pass USPTO Background check

  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust Clearance

  • U.S. citizen or work eligible legal resident who has resided in the U.S. for the last two years

It would be great if you also had . . .

  • Previous patent examining/patent searching experience

  • Highly skilled developing a search methodology and conducting searches.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to complete projects against deadlines.

  • Experience with Orbit, PatBase, Google Scholar or PatSeer

  • Master's degree or PhD is a plus

What will you be doing in this role?

  • On a weekly basis, accept projects with a defined due date based on your availability and the needs of Clarivate.

  • Demonstrate the ability to read a disclosure quickly and understand the technical nuances which may potentially distinguish it from the prior art.

  • Perform a comprehensive search to ensure the most relevant prior art is located and provide a logical and complete search history.

  • Prepare a written opinion applying the most relevant prior art to the disclosure.

  • Maintain proficiency with commercial patent searching databases and other proprietary databases of technical publications.

  • Stay abreast of best practices and changes to search procedures via self directed review of materials provided by Clarivate.

  • Maintain consistent timeliness and superior quality of deliverables.

  • Ensure compliance with Clarivate’s Code of Business Ethics and Corporate Conduct

Required Equipment for the job:

  • Reliable, High Speed Internet connection: at least 10 Mbps of download speed and 1 Mbps of upload speed of dedicated internet bandwidth

  • Secure work location, working from public areas is not permitted

  • Phone and voicemail service for business communication

Hours of Work

  • Flexible work hours

  • This is a remote position, but all work must be completed in the continental United States

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

Are you passionate about driving growth in the e-commerce space? Our client, Tucketts, an innovative US-based socks and foot care brand, is looking for an experienced E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager to join its team and lead strategic initiatives that will elevate the brand to new heights. This is a fully remote, full-time role.

This role will focus on creating and executing growth strategies across multiple channels, improving the customer journey, and maximizing our brand presence on social media, email, and other key platforms. If you have a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape, particularly with Shopify, and are data-driven, collaborative, and proactive, with a track record of achieving growth in a fast-paced e-commerce environment, please read on!

About the Company:

Tucketts is a rapidly growing e-commerce brand with a strong presence in the Shopify ecosystem and on Amazon. This women-owned company is dedicated to promoting foot health and wellness through a unique range of socks and foot care products. Tucketts mission is to empower individuals to prioritize their foot health while making a positive social impact through ethical manufacturing practices. The company prioritizes sustainability by creating eco-friendly products and supporting fair labor practices, ensuring a balance between people, profit, and the planet. Tucketts employs women in Colombia, supporting their economic empowerment, and contributes to educational initiatives for girls in the Maasai community in Tanzania, inspired by the founders journey up Mount Kilimanjaro.

Your Goals in This Role:

  • Leverage our customer base to boost sales and expand our social media reach.
  • Develop our Shopify brand through targeted e-commerce promotions, email marketing and digital campaigns
  • Double our sales and customer base.
  • Analyze performance data to continually improve ad spend efficiency and ROI.
  • Enhance our social media presence by growing our TikTok following and engaging with our Instagram influencers, followers, and email list.
  • Manage current team and hire new members according to the company's needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Devise and implement strategies to achieve ambitious sales targets and customer acquisition goals.
  • Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media, SEO, and PPC, to drive traffic and increase conversions.
  • Continuously analyze and optimize the website for user experience, performance, and conversion rates, implementing A/B testing and analytics to inform decisions.
  • Optimize our social media channels and influencers to amplify brand messaging and drive conversions.
  • Execute compelling e-commerce promotions that resonate with our target audience.
  • Develop and execute effective email marketing campaigns to nurture customer relationships and drive repeat purchases.
  • Manage and optimize advertising campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, and other relevant social media platforms.
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Tucketts online store, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers.
  • Monitor and analyze eCommerce performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement to achieve sales targets. Use data-driven approaches to make strategic decisions.
  • Find and collaborate with influencers to become brand ambassadors

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in a growth marketing or digital marketing role, within e-commerce.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing tools and strategies (SEO, PPC, etc).
  • Proficiency in Shopify, email marketing and social media platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform marketing strategies.
  • Creativity and innovation in developing engaging marketing campaigns.
  • Knowledge of Amazon specifics is a huge plus.
  • Comfortable with implementing automation tools and exploring AI to improve efficiency.
  • Creative thinker with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative mindset.
  • A strong desire to grow a company and demonstrate skills that lead to measurable impact.

What We Offer:

  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.

If you're a growth-focused marketer with a passion for e-commerce and a knack for driving customer engagement, wed love to hear from you!

raw.description:
About the Company

PreVeil is a fast-growing tech company transforming secure communication and compliance for the modern enterprise. Our encrypted email and file sharing platform combines end-to-end encryption with a simple user experience and has been named PC Magazine's Best Encrypted Email and File Sharing Solution five years running.

Trusted by more than 3,000 defense contractors, PreVeil has become the gold standard for protecting sensitive information and achieving compliance efficiently. We're profitable, growing 100% year-over-year, and building for the long term.

About the Role

PreVeil is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own core product strategy, drive execution, and build exceptional user experiences across our portfolio. You’ll sit at the intersection of customer insight, product excellence, and business goals—defining what we build, why we build it, and how we ship it with speed and impact. Think like an owner: every feature is an investment, every problem demands first-principles rigor, and you’re constantly prioritizing resources to deliver maximum value to users and the business.

This is a high-ownership role on a lean, fast-moving team empowered to solve hard product problems. You’ll move fast, dig deep to uncover real root causes, and rally engineering, design, and go-to-market teams around a clear, compelling vision. You won’t be doing it alone. You’ll collaborate closely with top-tier engineers, designers, and company leaders dedicated to building the future of secure and compliant communication and collaboration for the enterprise.

Product Judgment & Strategic Thinking

• Evaluate competing approaches rigorously, form a clear and well-reasoned point of view, and articulate tradeoffs with conviction

• Define and own the product roadmap for your area — set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and align the team around what matters most and why

• Operate at both the strategic and tactical level: think in years, execute in weeks

First Principles & Root Cause Thinking

• Dig beneath the surface of customer feedback and product problems to find the real underlying need, constraint, or opportunity

• Relentlessly ask why until you understand what's actually true — not just what's visible or what's been assumed

• Reason from fundamentals to reach better conclusions faster, especially in ambiguous or novel situations

Pattern Recognition & Connecting the Dots

• Spot connections others miss — draw on a broad base of experience to recognize when a new problem rhymes with an old one

• Connect signals across customers, market trends, and product gaps to form insight faster than the data alone would suggest

• Synthesize across disparate inputs — user research, eng constraints, competitive dynamics, business goals — into a coherent picture

Deep Customer & Market Understanding

• Develop a genuine, granular understanding of how customers think, work, and struggle — not just what they ask for

• Build relationships with customers directly; bring the voice of the user into every product decision

• Stay ahead of market trends and competitive dynamics to inform strategy and identify opportunities

Systems Thinking

• Understand how different parts of the product connect and affect each other — design solutions that work across the whole, not just the immediate problem

• Anticipate second-order effects of product decisions on users, engineering, and the business

• Hold the full product architecture in mind while working on specific problems

Systems Thinking

• Understand how different parts of the product connect and affect each other — design solutions that work across the whole, not just the immediate problem

• Anticipate second-order effects of product decisions on users, engineering, and the business

• Hold the full product architecture in mind while working on specific problems

Execution & Delivery Rigor

• Drive initiatives from discovery through launch with focus, discipline, and follow-through

• Break down complex problems into clear MVPs and iterative steps that ship with velocity and impact

• Be the kind of PM engineering and design can build with confidently — reliable, unblocking, and always moving things forward

Leadership, Motivation & Collaboration

• Lead and motivate without formal authority — earn trust and followership through clarity of vision, genuine respect, and consistency

• Keep the team aligned and energized through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities

• Partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market as a true peer — not a ticket writer or gatekeeper

Communication & Written Clarity

• Communicate with precision and confidence across audiences — customers, engineers, designers, and leadership

• Write sharp, clear product specs that reduce ambiguity and accelerate execution

• Distill complex technical and strategic topics into language anyone can act on

What We're Looking For

Core requirements

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning products end-to-end — strategy through launch through business outcomes
  • Enterprise B2B SaaS, collaboration or productivity software experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to deeply understand customers and translate that understanding into product decisions
  • Strong product instincts — you know what good looks like and can explain why
  • First principles thinker who digs to root causes and doesn't accept surface-level answers
  • Systems thinker who understands how product decisions ripple across the product, users, and the business
  • Growth mindset and genuine curiosity — you lead with questions, learn fast, and are truly open to feedback
  • Exceptional communicator — clear in writing, sharp in meetings, compelling to leadership
  • High-execution PM who drives things to completion and is deeply reliable
  • Leads and motivates without authority — earns trust through vision, respect, and consistency
  • Collaborative, low-ego, and maker-first — you thrive in a small team and take direction well

Important differentiators

  • Strong technical fluency — fluent in APIs, system architecture, and technical tradeoffs; can hold your own in engineering discussions
  • Familiarity with admin and end-user personas in enterprise software
  • Data-informed — uses quantitative metrics and qualitative research together, not one or the other
  • Ability to prototype ideas quickly using AI-assisted tools, or similar to validate and communicate concepts early
  • Actively uses AI as a force multiplier — e.g. research synthesis, written artifacts, prioritization analysis, and process efficiency
  • Pattern recognition — connects dots across customers, market signals, and product gaps faster than the data alone suggests
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity with a strong bias for action

Working Style & Culture Fit

This role is for someone who thinks rigorously and executes relentlessly — someone who earns the trust of their team through clarity, consistency, and care. You'll be joining a small team that moves fast and expects a lot, but also invests deeply in doing things right.

We value:

  • A strong point of view, formed through genuine investigation and held with intellectual honesty
  • Speed and decisiveness, paired with the rigor to know when to slow down and go deeper
  • People who make the team around them sharper, more aligned, and more motivated
  • The kind of reliability that means you don't have to be asked twice — and the judgment to know when to ask for help

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Our generative AI-powered products are revolutionizing the practice of medicine, and we’re looking for a highly motivated Data Engineer to join our growing US-based Data Engineering team. In this crucial role, you will build and optimize large scale data infrastructure to drive business decisions and machine learning research.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain scalable data services, pipelines and storage solutions for the feedback of unstructured application data for ML training and evaluation purposes.

  • Build and manage OLAP databases, ELTs and general data tooling for analytics , business decisions and products features.

  • Work closely with a team of frontend and backend engineers, product managers, and analysts.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Job Summary

The Chief Data Officer (CDO) is responsible for the organization's enterprise-wide data strategy, governance, quality, analytics, AI, and data-driven transformation.

Within an Insurance & Investments organization, the CDO ensures that data is treated as a strategic asset across underwriting, claims, customer management, investment/asset management, risk, finance, compliance, and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise data strategy and roadmap.

Establish enterprise-wide data governance, ownership, standards, policies, and controls.

Improve data quality, consistency, accuracy, availability, and accessibility.

Lead the organization's data management and data architecture strategy.

Establish data models, data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, and data integration capabilities.

Lead Business Intelligence (BI), analytics, reporting, and advanced analytics.

Develop and oversee AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics initiatives.

Support data-driven decision-making across insurance, investments, finance, risk, and operations.

Establish data governance frameworks covering data privacy, security, lineage, classification, and access.

Partner with the CIO/CTO and technology teams on data platforms and architecture.

Support regulatory and management reporting through reliable and controlled data.

Develop data capabilities for underwriting, claims, pricing, fraud detection, customer analytics, and risk management.

Support investment teams with portfolio analytics, market data, performance reporting, and investment intelligence.

Establish data KPIs and monitor data quality and governance performance.

Lead data transformation and modernization initiatives.

Manage relationships with data, analytics, AI, and technology vendors.

Build and lead data, analytics, BI, governance, and data-science teams.

Promote an enterprise-wide data-driven culture.

Present data strategy, risks, opportunities, and transformation progress to executive leadership and the Board.

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, technology, information management, or financial-services data.

5+ years in CDO, Chief Data Officer, Head of Data, Director of Data, Head of Analytics, or equivalent senior leadership positions.

Experience in insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, wealth management, or financial services preferred.

Strong expertise in:

Enterprise data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

Data quality & master data

Business intelligence

Advanced analytics

AI / machine learning

Data privacy & security

Data management

Data integration

Regulatory data

Cloud data platforms

Strong understanding of financial-services data and regulatory requirements.

Experience managing enterprise data transformation programs and large multidisciplinary teams.

Strong C-suite, Board, and business stakeholder engagement.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or related discipline; master's degree/MBA preferred.

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Ojibway-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Ojibway Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in Canada

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.25 - $1.40 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The OjibwayTelephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Ojibwayand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inOjibwayand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for OneHundredEighty (180)days from the posting date of May 18, 2026.

EEO/AA

LLS is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that employment opportunities are made and offered to individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law or local ordinance. LLS will reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities if the person is otherwise qualified to safely perform all of the essential functions of the position. Should you require accommodations to complete this application and/or the interview process, please let us know immediately.

Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race. color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic information or any other consideration prohibited by law or contract.

VEVRAA Federal Contractor requesting appropriate employment service delivery systems, such as state workforce agencies and local employment delivery systems, to provide priority referrals of protected veterans.

PAY TRANSPARENCY NONDISCRIMINATION PROVISION
The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-I.35(c)

raw.description:
Why Join HYCU?

HYCU is the fastest-growing leader in the multi-cloud data protection as a service industry. By bringing true SaaS-based data backup and recovery to both on-premises and cloud-native environments, the company provides unparalleled data protection, migration, disaster recovery and ransomware protection to thousands of companies worldwide. As an award-winning and recognized visionary in the industry, HYCU solutions eliminate complexity, risk and the high cost of legacy- based solutions, providing data protection simplicity to make the world safer. With an industry- leading NPS score of 91, customers experience frictionless, cost-effective data protection, anywhere, everywhere. HYCU has raised $140M in VC funding to date and is based in Boston, Mass. Learn more at .

Overview

As a Customer Success Engineer (CSE), you will be responsible for protecting and growing our SaaS and enterprise cloud customers. You will help Public Cloud and Enterprise administrators dramatically simplify and streamline their entire data protection stack. Identifying solutions to make implementation smooth and efficient, as well as sharing best practices that ease adoption and increase the effectiveness of our platform, are all a part of a typical day for our CSEs.

The successful candidate enjoys helping customers overcome challenges and achieve their business outcomes. You must be able to think critically to solve difficult technical problems and provide solutions that may not be apparent. The CSE must possess a deep understanding of multi-clouds and data protection and be able to communicate clearly and effectively.

Location:

  • Remote, Costa Rica

What You’ll Do:

  • Be a customer advocate: foster trust, transparency, and confidence with customers
  • Build coalition support (IT and business) with customers
  • Demonstrate a clear, detailed understanding of the customer’s technology and business challenges and goals
  • Value creator: Identify and articulate HYCU value through demonstrations of customer centricity and examples and help build case studies with these outcomes
  • Consumption: Analyze what customers are using versus needs while driving greater consumption of HYCU solution and increase customer value
  • Technical acumen: Apply customer needs, technical knowledge, product knowledge and deliver best technical value/architecture and successful deployments
  • Leverage social, phone, digital, chat to effectively reach and engage customers
  • Learning ability: Maintain technical skills and knowledge per market trends and collaborate with technical community
  • Make sure customer needs are met with constant and close collaboration with product management, engineering, and account management teams
  • Help drive product adoption, promote customer loyalty and on-time renewal
  • Measure customer knowledge on cloud/data protection/SaaS and help deliver enablement through partners
  • Meet and exceed target for GRR and net recurring revenue by creating opportunities with customers through trusted advisor/advocacy
  • Be a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on HYCU products (enterprise and public cloud solutions)
  • Focus on the following KPIs: ensuring the customer is leveraging the solution they invested in

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Equivalent with 5+ years in technical architecture, consulting/engagement, implementation and design or technical support
  • 4+ years of successful experience in SaaS/IT infrastructure/data protection in enterprise and public cloud, preferably with medium-large customers
  • Public cloud certifications are a plus (Azure/AWS/GCP)
  • Prior experience in solution architecture and/or solution design or strategic consulting
  • In-depth knowledge of Hybrid Cloud environment with IaaS and SaaS environment knowledge of at least one or more public clouds
  • Be customer obsessed and be the voice of customer through customer advocacy and work with internal teams to remove any blockers
  • Clear and effective communicator. Able to quickly grasp and explain technological and business concepts
  • Creative problem-solver and strategic thinker
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and converse with all levels of management
  • Possess a growth mindset, has a positive outlook, determined to make the customer a successful one

It’s Great if You Have:

  • B2B SaaS experience
  • Experience within data protection, cloud-native, security, data storage industries
  • Drive to build with fast-growing SaaS company

Attributes of a Successful HYCUer:

  • Strategic thinker who thinks outside the box
  • Takes responsibility and ownership for driving successful outcomes
  • Team collaborator who can inspire and motivate others
  • Hands-on and builders' mentality with an entrepreneurial mindset
  • Intellectual curiosity, always open for continuous learning
  • Results-driven with a winning attitude

Who We Are:

Our Core Values: Authenticity, Grit and Empathy are at the heart of everything we do at HYCU. All of us at HYCU take ownership in shaping and contributing to our culture. We pride ourselves in developing an inclusive and diverse company that supports our employees and customers to do extraordinary things.

The following is how we approach each Core Value:

  • Authenticity – To be authentic means to be who we are and do it well. Focus your energy on being who YOU are. Be true to yourself. Authenticity also extends to our products. Understanding where we are truly the best fit for our customers and when we are not. And finally, authenticity in relationships: ensuring that we are honest and do what we say we’re going to do.
  • Grit – To win we need to want it. Every team member needs to be able to jump in and help at every turn. Whether it’s staying late to help a colleague or customer or finding a better process and making sure it’s communicated cross-functionally. You just have to do it and love it…and never stop trying.
  • Empathy – We need to care about each other, about our clients, about our business, and about the world around us. That might seem like a tall order, but if we don’t live in a constant state of empathy, if we don’t strive to truly put ourselves in another person’s shoes, we cannot truly serve the market.

"We are at our best when we stay true to our Core Values." ~ Simon Taylor, CEO

What We Offer:

Come work for one of CRN’s “Cloud 100 Companies for 2026”. At HYCU you’ll have the opportunity to build your career with a “Visionary” B2B SaaS company from Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for BackUp and Data Protection Platforms. HYCU provides an excellent benefits package including Medical Insurance, generous time off, and more. We offer career development programs and an inclusive global culture. All our employees participatein our equity program.

Equal Opportunity Employer

HYCU is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

raw.description:
Account Executive — Talent Pipeline

Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond.

We're growing quickly and continuing to build our Sales organization. While we may not have an immediate Account Executive opening that aligns with your background, we're always interested in connecting with strong sales talent who may be a fit for future opportunities.

By joining our Account Executive Talent Pipeline, you'll be considered for upcoming roles as our team grows.

The Profiles We're Interested In

We're particularly interested in full-cycle Account Executives who know how to create their own opportunities, run strong sales processes, and close.

You might be a great fit for a future opportunity with Alternative Payments if you're energized by:

  • Owning your pipeline end to end, including outbound prospecting, account research, referrals, partnerships, and other creative approaches to generating pipeline.

  • Running the full sales cycle, from first touch through discovery, demo, negotiation, and close.

  • Managing a fast-moving pipeline while maintaining strong CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.

  • Building strategic account plans, mapping buying committees, and navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes.

  • Selling through business value and ROI, particularly to finance, operations, and executive stakeholders.

  • Working closely with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and other teams to improve how we go to market.

  • Contributing ideas, playbooks, processes, and best practices as our sales organization scales.

  • Consistently hitting or exceeding quota in a high-accountability sales environment.

What We're Typically Looking For

Future Account Executive opportunities may vary in level and scope, but strong candidates will typically bring:

  • Several years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with demonstrated success generating and closing their own pipeline.

  • A history of carrying and achieving or exceeding quota.

  • Strong outbound and prospecting capabilities across email, phone, social, events, referrals, and other channels.

  • Experience selling B2B SaaS, FinTech, payments, or another technical solution.

  • Confidence leading value-based conversations with senior business stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills and executive presence.

  • A proactive, ownership-oriented approach — you're comfortable operating independently and moving opportunities forward without waiting for direction.

  • Experience working with a modern sales tech stack such as Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools.

Bonus Points

We're especially interested in meeting people who have:

  • Experience in FinTech, payments, B2B SaaS, or startup/scale-up environments.

  • Sold to SMBs, MSPs, or service-based businesses.

  • Familiarity with accounts receivable, accounts payable, or financial operations workflows.

  • Helped build outbound playbooks or establish repeatable sales processes.

  • Mentored other sellers or helped raise the bar across a sales team.

Location

Our Sales team is primarily based in Toronto, and we operate in a hybrid environment with regular time together in the office on Monday, Tuesday and Wedensday.

Candidates must generally be eligible to work in Canada.

Compensation

Compensation will depend on the specific opportunity, level, experience, and scope of the role. Our sales compensation packages typically include a base salary, performance-based variable compensation, and equity.

Specific compensation details will be shared when you're being considered for an active opening.

Why Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Own your impact: Take meaningful ownership of deals and initiatives shaping the future of FinTech.

  • Build: Help define how we sell, operate, and scale — not simply inherit an established playbook.

  • Collaborate: Work alongside a team where strong ideas can come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Build your career as the company, product, and team continue to evolve.

  • Work on real problems: Help service-based businesses fundamentally improve how they manage and move money.

Our Values

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

You will act as Imprint's voice on social, developing the point of view, content strategy, and measurement framework that positions Imprint as a credible, compelling brand.

raw.description:
We are hiring a VC Analyst Intern to research the market and write what we find.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the ones that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

The role

Why is this company worth a look, and why now? Is this sector heating up, or is everyone already late to it? Which investor actually belongs in this round, and which one is only circling?

You answer those in writing. Every piece of work here is a memo. A view, the reasoning underneath it, and the part you are not sure about said out loud. The ones that hold up get published on our LinkedIn, the blog on our site, the newsletter and our X.

You also write for the two audiences we sell to. A family office and a pre seed founder want different things from the same piece of news, and a lot of what you write goes out from the founders' own accounts, in their voice.

You work with the two co-founders directly, and with our Head of Brand once that seat is filled. The org is very flat, so you learn straight from us how we screen, what we pass on and why.

This is a paid internship built to grow into a full time seat. We are looking for someone who already follows this market closely, has opinions about it, and wants to spend the next few years writing about it properly.

What you will own

  • Company memos. Why a company is interesting, who belongs in the round, and what would have to be true for it to fail.

  • Sector work. What is heating up, what is over owned, and the evidence behind both.

  • Investor research. Who is actually active, in what, at what stage, and what they are known for.

  • The published version of all of it, plus the pieces written for family offices and early stage founders that go out from the founders' accounts.

You are a fit if you

  • Already follow this market closely because you enjoy it. You can name the rounds from this quarter and say which ones you think are wrong.

  • Already write and research in this space, and turn that into memos or articles yourself.

  • Get the facts right. A wrong fund name, round size or attribution costs credibility we cannot buy back.

  • Use AI every day, and know where it should go nowhere near your work. Good judgement and taste on where it makes you faster, and where it degrades what you put out.

What we offer

Remote and async.

  • Close contact with the co-founders and our Head of Brand directly.

  • Close contact with our internal team.

  • Our network of highly established investors and the top deals out there.

  • Access to our internal processes, and to how we screen deal flow.

  • Learning very closely from all of us.

raw.title: (Senior) Finance Controller (all genders)
raw.excerpt: JustPlay is looking for a (Senior) Finance Controller (all genders) to join our growing Finance team.
raw.description:
JustPlay is looking for a (Senior) Finance Controller (all genders) to join our growing Finance team. Over the past years, we've grown significantly, and we're now backed by NCSoft as our strategic shareholder, with ambitious plans to keep growing. As we scale, our finance function needs to scale with us, and we're looking for a (Senior) Controller who owns the numbers that steer our business: shareholder reporting, budget and forecast, and the KPIs leadership relies on every week. You will directly report to the Associate Director of Finance and you'll be the finance partner for our core revenue and cost drivers and help build a controlling function that scales with the company. This is a growth role: you'll start by mentoring our FP&A team member, and in the mid-term take over leadership of the controlling function.

Job responsibilities

  • Shareholder reporting (NCSoft): Deliver the monthly management P&L and the quarterly consolidated balance sheet and P&L on time and in the shareholder's templates. Provide preliminary figures within a few days of month-end. Keep a clean bridge between management P&L and statutory figures.

  • Budget and forecast: Own the annual budget and a rolling forecast. Turn the overhead budget into a working budget-control process, with cost-center owners, monthly actual-vs-budget reviews and follow-up actions.

  • Business partnering: Be the finance counterpart for Revenue Generation / Ad Monetisation, User Acquisition, User Payments (payouts and rewards) and the G&A cost centers, with profitability as the focus.

  • Cost control: Build levers and tracking for the largest cost blocks: personnel, SaaS, cloud, consulting, and payment fees (PayPal, FX).

  • Analysis: Run variance analysis against budget, forecast and weekly flash, build scenario models, and prepare quarterly business reviews.

  • Data integrity: Establish Metabase/Looker as a reliable source of finance KPIs. Reconcile BI data against invoices and the ledger, own the KPI definitions and remove double counts and manual add-ons.

  • Liquidity: Work with Treasury on the liquidity forecast (network payout timing, UA spend, user cash-outs).

  • Interface with accounting: Work with the Accounting Lead on the in-house month-end close, including accruals input, cut-off, and cost center and chart of accounts design in DATEV.

  • Team: Mentor and review the work of our junior FP&A team member, and grow into the leadership of the controlling function in the mid-term.

Job requirements

  • 6+ years in controlling or FP&A, with at least 2 years in a scale-up or digital B2C business; mobile apps, gaming or ad-tech is strongly preferred.

  • Proven experience reporting to a corporate or strategic shareholder or a PE owner, including multi-entity consolidation and delivering to external templates under deadline.

  • End-to-end ownership of a full budget and forecast cycle, including building driver-based models.

  • Self-sufficient with data: hands-on with a BI tool (Metabase/Looker) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets

  • Solid accounting foundation (accruals, FX, revenue recognition), with enough IFRS/HGB knowledge to reconcile management and statutory figures.

  • Fluent English (written and verbal). German is a strong plus, given our work with PwC, DATEV and the local entities.

Nice-to-have

  • Understanding of Ad monetisation and User Acquisition economics: network revenue and payout terms, eCPM, ROAS/LTV, and marketing spend cycles.

  • Experience with an Asian corporate parent or group reporting calendar

  • Hands-on experience with DATEV, Moss or Embat

  • Experience building a controlling function or KPI governance from scratch

  • Familiarity with multi-currency (USD/EUR) payment flows and FX effects

  • First experience mentoring or leading finance team members

Job benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc.

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, freeWellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

* Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining model.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

  • Identify emerging trends, technologies, and market disruptions

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.excerpt: Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week Check out this Loom video for more details: We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
raw.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

About Us:

Blockworks is an information platform that sits at the center of the crypto industry. Blockworks connects investors and businesses in onchain capital markets. You love moving quickly in a fast-paced start-up, but you also bring intentionality, sustainability and scalability to your approach as an engineer.

What You’ll Do:

As our Senior Data Engineer, you will be directly responsible for leading the creation and execution of our data models and strategies that feed our products. You'll work collaboratively with other members of the engineering team to design, develop, implement, and evolve our data pipeline and approaches.

Every day will look a little different, but in general, you will do things like:

  • Own Data Sourcing Pipelines: You'll be responsible for helping to architect our data warehousing, ingestion and sourcing strategy, working with multiple SDKs to aggregate data from various sources into Blockwork's own data warehouse.

  • Design and Implement ETL Solutions: You'll be responsible for implementing our overall ETL approach, including accessing & setting up blockchain nodes to pull from, sourcing data from 3rd parties, and modeling our internal schemas across our PostgreSQL and Clickhouse databases

  • Grow Shared Knowledge: You'll help provide technical leadership, guidance, and assistance to the team in the implementation of established architectures and designs.

  • Drive Operational Efficiency: You'll be constantly looking for opportunities to improve data workflows and reliably automate routine tasks.

Experimentation is frequent at Blockworks. Comfortability with being uncomfortable is a must.

What You’ve Done Before:

For this role, first and foremost, you must have significant knowledge of the crypto industry; interest in crypto is not enough, we're looking for someone who considers themself crypto native. You have at least 4 (but ideally more) years of hands-on experience with data modeling, schema design, data operations, and data warehousing.

During that time, you've personally built backend systems at scale with a focus on data processing and ingestion. You're an ace at Python, Go, Rust and/or Typescript, and you bring incredibly strong expertise in SQL (ideally Parquet, Postgres, and Clickhouse). You have deep experience creating data warehouses at scale (100M+ rows per day), and you also bring experience using DevOps tools and cloud solutions like Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or GCP. You’re also comfortable working with modern data orchestration tools like Airflow or Dagster, and have hands-on experience with SQL transformation frameworks such as dbt or SQLMesh to build, test, and manage production-grade data pipelines.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

Secure BJAK's AI-enabled products and agent workflows using third-party models. Focus on customer data shared with model providers, agent permissions, user data isolation, and prompt injection through uploaded documents and other untrusted content.

What You Will Build

  • Assess customer data sent to third-party model vendors, including minimization, vendor controls, retention, logging, and approved use.

  • Design controls limiting AI agent permissions, tools, actions, and system access using least privilege and explicit authorization.

  • Implement and test tenant and user data isolation across prompts, conversation history, retrieval, memory, and AI-connected services.

  • Threat model and test prompt injection and indirect injection through uploaded documents, retrieved content, links, and other untrusted inputs.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on safe document ingestion, content handling, output validation, and approval for sensitive actions.

  • Support SC TRM and BNM RMiT for AI technology risks, including assessments, third-party oversight, control evidence, and remediation.

  • Build security tests, monitoring, and response procedures for AI misuse, data exposure, unauthorized actions, and vendor incidents.

What We Look For

  • Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, AI, or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years in application security, product security, security engineering, or AI system security.

  • Experience implementing or owning SC TRM and BNM RMiT controls, technology risk, or regulatory control evidence.

  • Understanding of third-party LLM integrations, model APIs, agent tools, RAG, and AI application architectures.

  • Knowledge of prompt injection, indirect injection, cross-user data leakage, excessive agent permissions, and vendor data disclosure risks.

  • Programming or scripting skills, preferably Python and TypeScript/Node.js, plus APIs and AWS or GCP.

  • Able to collaborate with Product, Legal, Compliance, Data, and Engineering on practical controls and risk communication.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
